turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My in-laws are coming Sunday and I want to make something impressive but not stressful.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A slow roast is hard to mess up. Would you rather do a roast chicken, a lamb shoulder, or a vegetarian lasagna?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are we still going to your sister's on Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: She cancelled, the baby's got a cold.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no, poor thing. So we're free all day then?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Looks like it. We could finally clear out the garage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could not do that and go for a long lunch instead.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Garage in the morning, lunch after. That's my offer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. You were choosing a main for Sunday, chicken, lamb or lasagna?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think the lamb. My father-in-law loves lamb.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then lamb it is. Rub it with garlic and rosemary and give it about four hours low and slow.
